device.description: Dual 12-bit voltage-output DAC with internal reference, 14-bit serial shift-register input and LOADDACS strobe
device.note: dac7612.pdf (Burr-Brown) p.2 specifications (VDD 4.75-5.25 V, VIH 0.7 VDD, straight binary), p.3 pin configuration and descriptions (SO-8), p.4 equivalent input logic, p.5 timing diagrams, logic truth table (A1 A0 select), data input table and timing specifications, p.10 operation and interface (14 serial bits: A1 A0 D11-D0; LOADDACS transparent latch)

registers.name: IN_A
registers.note: the serial shift register's data as addressed to DAC A (the device has one 14-bit shift register, p.4); power-on value not specified

registers.name: IN_B
registers.note: the serial shift register's data as addressed to DAC B; power-on value not specified

registers.name: DAC_A
registers.note: DAC A register, transparent latch while LOADDACS is low with A1 A0 = 0X or 10 (p.5 truth table)

registers.name: DAC_B
registers.note: DAC B register, transparent latch while LOADDACS is low with A1 A0 = 0X or 11 (p.5 truth table)

commands.name: A1 A0 = 0X: both DACs
commands.note: p.5 truth table: A1 = L loads DAC A and DAC B

protocol.note: 14 bits B0-B13 = A1 A0 D11-D0, MSB first on rising CLK while CS is low (p.5 data input table); the shift register keeps the last 14 bits

pages: p.2 (VDD, logic levels, data coding), p.3 (pins, ordering), p.4 (input logic), p.5 (timing, truth table, data input table), p.10 (interface)
notModeled: analog outputs and internal 2.435-V reference (outputs never driven)

one shared 14-bit shift register: LOADDACS low loads only the DAC(s) its A1 A0 bits select; the model keeps a per-channel input register and LOADDACS updates both channels from them (a channel whose input register was written but not loaded before another channel's write also updates)
the shift register is updated bit by bit: with LOADDACS low the DAC registers follow each new bit; the model writes when CS rises
CS and CLK are interchangeable (the shift clock is CS OR CLK, p.4); the model shifts only on CLK edges while CS is low
power-on register contents are not specified (modeled as 0)
variants: DAC7612 has its own datasheet; DAC7611 is the single-channel version (12-bit word, LD and CLR pins)
